description: Poster-first hero video: the still image is the LCP element and the video is deferred behind reduced-motion and Save-Data gates.

requires.runtime: none — native <video>; self-host the media under public/media/
requires.authoring: a poster image plus an MP4 (and optionally a WebM/AV1 sibling)
requires.note: Autoplay is muted-only by browser policy. The poster stays in the DOM (opacity, not display) so the accessible name survives the swap.
